global_rule: Every blocker is a frozen research question with explicit evidence, hostile controls, and nonpromotion terminals. No manuscript score or green workflow substitutes for the named evidence.

lanes.promotion_ceiling: Formal positive-rule theorems remain valid under a null real-case terminal; broad policy/AI-safety impact does not.
